{{Quote|Lot Niss, please meet your party of one Human and one Houk in the entry hall.|An announcement on the Grand Terminals speaker system|<ref name="ZT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030724takedown|text=Zygerrian Takedown|int=Zygerrian Takedown}}</ref>}}
'''Lot Niss''' was a false named used as a signal by intelligence agents on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]]. The agents were tracking a [[Unidentified Bagman|courier]] carrying [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] meant as payment to the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] family named the [[Thanda clan]] from a rich shipping magnate named [[Brevis Taug]]. When the courier arrived at the [[Grand Terminal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Junction they played an announcement including the name Lot Niss over the Terminal's speaker system to alert a group of hired [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] staking out the area as to the arrival and identity of the courier.<ref name="ZT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lot Niss was first used in ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'', an adventure released online for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] produced by [[Wizards of the Coast]] and written by [[Jason Fry]]. If Lot Niss is actually an existing individuals name is not made clear.
